issues.title: Roadmap isolation violation in discard.rs doc comment
issues.why_it_matters: AGENTS.md and the task rules enforce strict roadmap isolation: code and comments must never reference roadmap phases, slices, or files so the codebase remains self-contained after roadmap/ is deleted.
issues.impact: Breaks roadmap isolation and leaks roadmap slice numbering into production code comments.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-write/src/discard.rs:16: `//! - Transport-level confirmation plumbing (slice-16 MCP binding) and compliance`
issues.proposed_fix: Remove `(slice-16 MCP binding)` and replace with `(transport-level MCP binding)`.

issues.title: Dry-run reports success on already-discarded items
issues.why_it_matters: Destructive confirmation dry-run (§4.9.2) should validate whether a discard will succeed. Because get_item_identity does not filter discarded_at IS NULL, an unconfirmed call on an already-discarded item returns DryRun(identity) indicating it would be discarded, but the subsequent confirmed call fails with InvalidArgument.
issues.impact: Inconsistency between dry-run and execution paths; false confidence given to callers during dry run.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-write/src/discard.rs:160-166: `let identity = args.store.get_item_identity(bank, args.item_id)?.ok_or_else(...); DiscardOutcome::DryRun(identity)` combined with `SELECT category, epistemic_kind FROM items WHERE id = ?1 AND bank_id = ?2` in crates/clio-store/src/sqlite_discard.rs:36.
issues.proposed_fix: Update get_item_identity SQL to include `AND discarded_at IS NULL`, or have ItemIdentity include a discarded flag so the dry-run path rejects already-discarded items with the same error as confirmed discard.

issues.title: Concurrent discard race returns ErrorCode::Internal
issues.why_it_matters: In a race condition where two callers attempt to discard the same item concurrently, both may pass the initial lookup, but only one will update the row. The loser encounters n == 0 and receives an Internal server error instead of the expected InvalidArgument (already discarded) error.
issues.impact: Surfaces misleading 500/Internal errors to operators or callers under concurrent access.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-store/src/sqlite_discard.rs:100-105: `if n == 0 { return Err(AmError::new(ErrorCode::Internal, "discard update matched zero rows")); }`
issues.proposed_fix: On n == 0, query the item again to confirm if it was discarded by a concurrent transaction, and return ErrorCode::InvalidArgument if so.

issues.title: Test suite lacks coverage for discarding episodic items
issues.why_it_matters: Episodic memory items have NULL category in the database schema. All existing tests in discard_tests.rs exclusively test semantic items with a populated category (ToolConfig). Although the code uses Option<String>, this path is not exercised by tests.
issues.impact: Testing gap for episodic memory item discard lifecycle.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-store/src/discard_tests.rs:45-67 only constructs semantic items via sample_semantic; crates/clio-write/src/discard_tests.rs:37-59 only constructs semantic items.
issues.proposed_fix: Add an episodic item creation and discard test case to discard_tests.rs in both clio-store and clio-write.

strengths: Clean dual-backend implementation with identical contract tests running on SQLite and Postgres.
Zero schema migrations needed; leverages pre-existing discarded_at/discard_reason columns.
Strict adherence to PR-6 and §7.4 boundaries: zero DEK or content interaction.

plan_1hr: Fix roadmap isolation comment in crates/clio-write/src/discard.rs:16 by removing (slice-16 MCP binding).
Update get_item_identity in SQLite and Postgres to filter WHERE id = ?1 AND bank_id = ?2 AND discarded_at IS NULL so dry-run rejects already-discarded items consistently with confirmed discard.
Add test cases for dry-run on already-discarded item and discard on episodic items in clio-store and clio-write.

Integrate discard event emission into uniform audit_trail event logging once slice 100180 is implemented.
Add automatic background index cleanup hooks for discarded items across dense vector and lexical index stores.
